inputs.name: cloudflared_version
inputs.description: cloudflared release to install, such as "2026.10.6". Change checksums with it.

inputs.name: checksums
inputs.description: SHA-256 of the release binary for each architecture, from the release's notes. Change these with cloudflared_version.

inputs.name: tunnel_token
inputs.description: Token of the remotely managed tunnel to run, from the Cloudflare dashboard or API. Required on every plan and apply, unless quick_tunnel_url is set.

inputs.name: quick_tunnel_url
inputs.description: Local URL to serve through a temporary trycloudflare.com Quick Tunnel instead of a named tunnel, such as "http://localhost:8080". Cloudflare offers Quick Tunnels for testing and development only. Takes the place of tunnel_token.

inputs.name: extra_args
inputs.description: More flags for cloudflared tunnel, such as ["--protocol=http2"]. They land in the systemd unit, so they can't carry a token.
